# Papu Plan

> Papu Plan brings recipes, weekly meal planning, nutrition tracking, and shopping lists together. The interface is available in English and Czech.

Personal recipes, meal plans, and account data require sign-in. The links below describe the public product and its policies.

## Product

- [Overview](https://papuplan.cz/): Product introduction and how meal planning works.
- [Plans and pricing](https://papuplan.cz/pricing): Free features and Pro automation.

## Policies

- [Terms and Conditions](https://papuplan.cz/legal/terms): Terms for using Papu Plan.
- [Privacy Policy](https://papuplan.cz/legal/privacy): Information about personal data and privacy.
